materialization.note: DERIVED HERE, and not the THUMBNAIL bundle IRIS generates. These bytes were rendered here from page 1 of 9789241550581-eng.pdf by cat-harness-tools/scripts/pdf-cover.py (pymupdf 2.0) on 2026-10-30, scaled to 300px wide from a 453.54x680.32pt page. The ORIGINAL is referenced, not held: a GitHub runner (https://github.com/litlfred/who-iris/actions/runs/41121073472) fetched it from https://iris.who.int/items/d0fe15da-15f9-4ba5-bfe4-73658e98db6a, matched it against the sha256 the ORIGINAL bitstream records, rendered this cover and discarded the PDF (who-iris#126). So `gen-covers --check` verifies these bytes, digest and dimensions but cannot re-render them. MASKED: the WHO emblem and wordmark are blanked to flat grey before these bytes are written -- see `maskedRegions`.

maskedRegions.reason: the WHO emblem and the "World Health Organization" wordmark. The owner ruled on 2026-09-21 that the emblem on a cover counts as "logo and other branding", which this replica must not carry until it is published under WHO, and chose masking over withholding the covers. Region set by eye on the rendering (who-iris#126).
